meta.description: How SkillQuest protects your data and respects your privacy. GDPR compliant privacy policy.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content:
Welcome to SkillQuest. We are committed to protecting your personal data and respecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and protect data when you visit our website skill-quest.app or use our SkillQuest mobile app.

This policy complies with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and Dutch and European data protection legislation.

dataController.title: Data Controller
dataController.content:
SkillQuest is the data controller for your personal information.

The data controller is Johannes Willem Vlasblom, sole proprietorship (eenmanszaak), trading as SkillQuest and Zenith Reborn, Catharina Hoeve 13, 2804 HE Gouda, the Netherlands (KvK number 42188670). Contact: hello@skill-quest.app.

whatDataDoWeCollect.title: What Data Do We Collect?
whatDataDoWeCollect.content:
### 3.1 Website Analytics

We use Vercel Analytics to collect anonymous usage data, including:

  • Page views and navigation patterns
  • Browser type and version
  • Device information (desktop/mobile/tablet)
  • Geographical location (country/region level only)
  • Referral sources

Vercel Analytics operates without cookies and does not track individual users.

### 3.2 Android Alpha Updates

If you sign up for SkillQuest updates or Android alpha information, we collect:

  • Email address (required)
  • Name (optional)
  • Platform preference (Android)

This data is securely stored in Supabase (EU servers) and used to keep you informed about SkillQuest updates.

### 3.3 Contact Forms

If you contact us via a contact form, we collect:

  • Your name
  • Email address
  • Subject and message content

This information is sent via Resend to hello@skill-quest.app for customer support.

### 3.4 SkillQuest Mobile App

When you use the SkillQuest app, we collect app data such as:

  • Account Data: Username, email, profile picture (optional)
  • Skill Tracking Data: Skills, timer logs, XP, levels, streaks
  • Family Mode Data: Parent-child account relationships, consent settings
  • Device Data: Device ID for push notifications, app version
  • Analytics: In-app usage patterns (anonymously aggregated)

All app data is stored locally on your device and optionally synchronized to our secure servers for backup and cross-device sync.

### 3.5 Anonymous usage statistics in the app

To see which features are used, the app sends a small, fixed set of anonymous events to Aptabase (EU servers, Germany): which screen is opened, which timer technique is started, completed or abandoned, whether the first timer was completed, when the subscription page is shown and whether the age question was answered.

  • No identifiers: no account ID, device ID, advertising ID, name, email address, skill name or free text is sent.
  • Not linked to you: the events are not linked to your account. Aptabase uses a random, short-lived ID per session and does not store your IP address.
  • The same for everyone: this applies to all users, including guests and children, because nothing is collected that can be traced back to a person. No profiles are built and nothing is used for advertising.

The optional Firebase Analytics, which you switch on yourself in your profile settings, is separate from this.

### 3.6 Tester feedback

Through the feedback form on skill-quest.app you can tell us anonymously what you think of the app. We only store your answers, your device type, the language of the page and whether we may quote your answer without your name. We don't ask for your name or email address. To limit abuse we store a one-way code (hash) of your IP address that changes every day, never the IP address itself. We keep feedback for at most 2 years.

### 3.7 Premium subscriptions

If you use Premium, the Apple App Store or Google Play handles the payment itself. To know which subscription you have, the app uses RevenueCat (United States), which processes this data for us. RevenueCat receives:

  • a random ID: the ID of your SkillQuest account, or an anonymous ID if you are not signed in (no name and no email address);
  • which product you bought, and the proof of purchase from Apple or Google;
  • technical information, such as the type of device and the operating system, and when you last used the app.

We use this to give you Premium and to keep your subscription status up to date. RevenueCat stores the data on servers in the United States, protected by Standard Contractual Clauses. For more details, see RevenueCat's privacy policy (revenuecat.com/privacy) and its data processing agreement (revenuecat.com/dpa).

### 3.8 Parent or guardian information

Only when a parent is asked for permission (see Children and Privacy) do we receive the email address of the parent or guardian and the nickname of the child. We store the address protected (hashed and encrypted) and use it for the request email, one reminder and a confirmation after a yes. These emails are sent through Resend.

The copy of the address that we keep for the request is deleted at once when the parent refuses or says it is not their child. It is also deleted when there is no answer within 7 days, when no account is set up within 30 days after a yes, and when the permission ends for any reason: an hourly clean-up takes care of this, and when a child takes the permission back we first send the parent one last email, at most a few days later. To limit abuse we keep a protected fingerprint of the address and of the network (IP) address of the request for 24 hours, never the address itself.

After a yes, if the parent does not have a SkillQuest account yet, we create one for that email address (without a password) so that the parent can follow the child. That account, with its email address, stays until the parent deletes it.

As proof of the decision we keep what was decided, when, which version of the information the parent saw, and the IP address and browser details of the parent at that moment. We also keep this for a refusal or when someone says it is not their child, because we must be able to show whether permission was given (see Data Retention).

### 3.9 Age question

Before you sign in, the app asks for the month and year of birth and the country. On the phone only the outcome is kept: adult or below the age of consent, a rough age band and the country. After you sign in, the server stores the date of birth, the age band, the country and the permission settings, and uses them for child-safe settings. For a child whose account was set up through a parent's permission there is no date of birth, only the age band, the country and a date to ask again.

On iOS 26.2 and newer, in a region where the law requires age checks, the app may ask Apple's Declared Age Range service whether the Apple Account is below the age of consent of your country. Apple answers with an age range, never a birth date, and you can decline. We only use the answer to make the age question stricter.

howDoWeUseYourData.title: How Do We Use Your Data?
howDoWeUseYourData.content:
We use your data for:

  • Improving User Experience: Analytics help us understand how visitors use our website
  • Product Updates: Email notifications about Android testing and product updates
  • Customer Support: Responding to inquiries and support requests
  • App Functionality: Skill tracking, progress synchronization, family mode features
  • Legal Compliance: Fulfilling legal obligations

We never sell or rent your personal data to third parties. We do not display advertisements and do not use tracking pixels.

legalBasisForProcessing.title: Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasisForProcessing.content:
Under the GDPR, we process your data based on:

  • Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)): Waitlist registrations, contact forms, app account creation
  • Legitimate Interest (Art. 6(1)(f)): Website analytics, security monitoring, service improvement
  • Contractual Necessity (Art. 6(1)(b)): Providing app services you request

You can withdraw your consent at any time by contacting us.

howDoWeProtectYourData.title: How Do We Protect Your Data?
howDoWeProtectYourData.content:
We take the following security measures:

  • HTTPS Encryption: All data transfer is encrypted
  • Secure Database Access: Strict access controls and authentication
  • Regular Security Updates: Systems are kept up-to-date
  • Limited Access: Only authorized personnel have access to your data
  • Data Minimization: We only collect what is strictly necessary

While we implement strong security measures, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security.

thirdpartyServices.title: Third-Party Services
thirdpartyServices.content:
We use the following GDPR-compliant services:

| Service | Purpose | Location | GDPR Status |

|--------|------|---------|-------------|

| Vercel | Website hosting and analytics, and the pages where a parent decides and where you delete your account | EU/US | Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) |

| Supabase | Database for waitlist and app data | EU servers | GDPR-compliant |

| RevenueCat | Managing Premium subscriptions in the app | US | Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) |

| Resend | Email delivery for contact forms, the emails to a parent and the account deletion code | US | GDPR-compliant, SCC |

| Google Play Services | Android closed testing and app distribution | US | GDPR-compliant |

| Aptabase | Anonymous in-app usage statistics | EU (Germany) | GDPR-compliant, no personal data |

| Apple Declared Age Range | Age check where the law requires it (iOS only) | Apple | Age range only, never a birth date |

All these services have appropriate safeguards for data transfer to countries outside the EU.

cookiesAndTracking.title: Cookies and Tracking
cookiesAndTracking.content:
### Minimal Cookie Usage

  • Vercel Analytics: No cookies, completely anonymous analytics
  • Strictly Necessary Cookies: Only for essential website functionality (session management)

### What We DO NOT Use

  • ❌ Advertising cookies
  • ❌ Third-party tracking pixels
  • ❌ Social media trackers
  • ❌ Cross-site tracking

You can manage cookies through your browser settings.

yourGdprRights.title: Your GDPR Rights
yourGdprRights.content:
As an EU/EEA resident, you have the following rights:

  • Right to Access (Art. 15): Request a copy of your personal data
  • Right to Rectification (Art. 16): Correct inaccurate or incomplete data
  • Right to Erasure (Art. 17): "Right to be forgotten" - request deletion of your data
  • Right to Data Portability (Art. 20): Receive your data in a machine-readable format
  • Right to Object (Art. 21): Object to processing based on legitimate interest
  • Right to Restriction of Processing (Art. 18): Restrict the processing of your data
  • Right to Withdraw Consent: Withdraw previously given consent
  • Email us at hello@skill-quest.app with your request
  • We will respond within 30 days as required by the GDPR
  • Identity verification may be required for security purposes

You have the right to file a complaint with the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP) in the Netherlands if you are dissatisfied with how we process your data.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.content:
We retain your data only as long as necessary:

  • Website Analytics: Indefinite (anonymized, no personal identification)
  • Update Emails: Until you unsubscribe
  • Contact Form Data: Maximum 2 years for customer support purposes
  • App Account Data: Until you delete your account
  • Account deletion: In the app or at app.skill-quest.app/delete-account. The account and its data are deleted after 7 days; until then the deletion can be cancelled. Not deleted at that moment: the proof of a parent's decision (see below) and copies in backups until those backups expire.
  • Email address of a parent: The copy kept for a permission request is deleted as soon as it is no longer needed (see 3.8). An account that we created for a parent keeps its email address until the parent deletes it.
  • Proof of a parent's decision: Until one year after the child reaches the age of consent of the country; for a refusal, or when someone says it is not their child, one year after the decision. Where we do not know the date of birth we use the latest possible date.

You can request deletion of your data at any time.

childrenAndPrivacy.title: Children and Privacy
childrenAndPrivacy.content:
SkillQuest is for adults and children. We show no advertising, we do not sell personal data, and we do not use it to build profiles of children.

### Who needs a parent's permission

Every country has an age of consent for online services (for example 16 in the Netherlands, 15 in France, 14 in Spain and Italy, and 13 in the United States, the United Kingdom and Belgium; where we have no specific rule we use 16). Below that age a child can only keep an account with the permission of a parent or guardian. Until a parent says yes, the progress stays on the child's own device and nothing is collected. The parent decides on a page that we send by email, after reading what we collect and who sees what.

### What we collect about a child, with permission

Login details (an email address and password, or a login code that the parent creates), the nickname and avatar, the practice sessions (which skill and how long) and the experience points (XP), a push-notification address of the device, and the anonymous usage events described in 3.5. For a child profile we send no crash reports and no Firebase analytics.

### Who sees what

The parents in the family group see the same about the child, and one permission covers all of them. Without a paid family plan they see how many minutes the child practised in the last 7 days and the last day the child practised. With the paid family plan they also see the sessions, the experience points, the skills and the recent activity, and they can start a timer for the child. Other members of the group only see the nickname and the avatar. The child can see that the parents follow the progress. Friends stay off until a parent switches them on. A child profile cannot make purchases and has no chat.

### Notifications

A child can get a reminder in the evening when they have not practised yet, and a summary of their progress. The messages carry no name, and the child can switch the reminder off in the app. Without a valid permission of a parent, and before the child reaches the age of consent, no message is sent.

### What the child and the other parent can do

The child can take the permission back in the app: new progress is then no longer saved and the parents can no longer follow it. The child can turn it back on. Another parent in the family group can object to the permission: it then ends at once, and nobody can give permission again until that parent withdraws the objection.

A parent in the child's family group can view the child's data, download it, withdraw the permission or have the account deleted (after 7 days) on the page linked in the email, or by writing to hello@skill-quest.app.

### Growing up

When a child reaches the age of consent of their country, the app asks the child once whether the parents keep following the progress. Nothing changes for the parents until the child chooses. At 18 the account becomes an adult account, and a permission that the child did not choose to keep ends. This only happens where we know the date of birth; for a child set up through a parent's permission we do not, so the account does not change by age by itself.

If you think we hold data of a child without a parent's permission, write to hello@skill-quest.app and we will delete it.

internationalDataTransfer.title: International Data Transfer
internationalDataTransfer.content:
Some of our third-party services (e.g., Vercel, Resend, RevenueCat) may store data on servers in the United States. We ensure that:

  • All transfers are protected by Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) approved by the European Commission
  • Services comply with GDPR requirements
  • Appropriate technical and organizational measures are implemented

Your primary app data is stored on EU servers (Supabase EU region).

changesToThisPrivacyPolicy.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
changesToThisPrivacyPolicy.content:
We may update this privacy policy from time to time. When we do:

  • We will post the updated date at the top of this document
  • For material changes, we will send additional notification via:
  • Email (for email subscribers and app users)
  • Prominent banner on our website
  • In-app notification (for app users)

We encourage you to review this policy periodically to stay informed.

contactUs.title: Contact Us
contactUs.content:
If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this privacy policy or your personal data:

We strive to respond to general inquiries within 5 business days and to formal GDPR requests within 30 days.

meta.title: Delete your SkillQuest account

deleteAccount.heading: Account deletion
deleteAccount.subtitle: Delete your SkillQuest account and the data linked to it.
deleteAccount.intro: In the SkillQuest app you can delete your account under Settings > Account deletion. Without the app you can use our deletion page: enter the email address of your account and we send you a code to check that the account is yours. Your account and data are deleted after 7 days, and you can cancel until then. If that does not work for you, you can still ask us by email.

cta.title: Delete your account without the app
cta.description: On our deletion page you enter the email address of your account. We send a code to that address to check that the account is yours.

steps.email: Send an email to {email} from the email address associated with your SkillQuest account.
steps.subject: Use the subject: "{subject}".
steps.includeTitle: Include the following in your email:

includeItems.optionalDetails: Optional: your username/user ID and any additional details that can help us locate your account

steps.verification: To protect your account, we may ask you to verify ownership before deletion.
steps.processing: We will confirm receipt and then process the deletion request.

items.account: Your account and profile information (e.g., email, display name, avatar).
items.progress: Your skills and progress stored in our backend (sessions, XP, streaks and history).
items.social: Your social data stored in our backend (friends, challenges, messages).
items.push: Push notification tokens linked to your account.

whatWeMayRetain.title: What we may retain
whatWeMayRetain.note: Some information may be retained if required for legal, security, or fraud-prevention reasons.

items.payments: Payment and transaction records managed by app stores and payment providers (e.g., purchase receipts).
items.subscriptions: Subscription status is managed by Google Play / Apple. Deleting your account does not automatically cancel subscriptions; please cancel in the store if needed.
items.support: Support communications (e.g., emails) for up to 2 years for customer support purposes.
items.security: Security and fraud-prevention logs as needed to keep our services safe.
items.analytics: Aggregated and anonymized analytics that cannot be linked back to you.
items.parentProof: If a parent gave or refused permission for a child: the proof of that decision (what was decided, when, and the parent's IP address and browser details), as described in our privacy policy.

timing.title: How long does it take?
timing.body: Deletion requested in the app or on our deletion page is carried out after 7 days. Email requests are usually handled within 30 days.
timing.note: If we need to retain certain information, we will explain what we keep and why.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: If you have questions or issues requesting deletion, contact us at {email}.
